apps.localizedDescription:
Rosebed:

Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 rewritten in Zig, with a client and a dedicated server. It is a port of the original game's decompiled source, obtained with RetroMCP-Java, and matches it: same behavior, same worlds from the same seed, and multiplayer that works with it.

Index:

• Extras not in b1.7.3.

Play:

Play in the browser.

Extras not in b1.7.3:

• A fullscreen option in Video Settings (vanilla only has F11).
• Optional mipmaps and anisotropic filtering in Video Settings, off by default.
• Touch controls on Android and iOS: fixed, floating or d-pad movement, a minimal button layout, and auto-jump.
• Gamepad support on every platform.

Other commands:

Debug builds (plain zig build) may be too slow to play.

Web:

The site ends up in zig-out/www.

versions.localizedDescription:
Added:

• Floating joystick and a minimal button layout for touch controls.
• Optional mipmaps and anisotropic filtering in Video Settings.

Changed:

• /help lists each command as - command: description.
• Faster chunk meshing, level ticks and terrain generation.

Fixed:

• The achievements tree no longer overflows its frame when panning.
• Moving the camera on touch screens no longer breaks blocks by accident.
